title: 2 Units, Sleeps 24  Nashville's Best Location
description:
Two connected homes. Eight bedrooms. One unforgettable Nashville trip. Nestled in the vibrant heart of 8th Ave South, this luxury two-unit compound is built for groups who want it all — expansive open-concept living, premium amenities, and a prime location just minutes from Broadway, Zanies Comedy Club, and the city's best dining and nightlife. Whether you're celebrating a milestone or just need room to spread out in style, this is your ultimate Nashville home base.

The space
COMBINED, YOUR GROUP ENJOYS:
🛏️ 8 Bedrooms across both units
🛁 6 Bathrooms (4 full + 2 half)
👑 2 Kings | 6 Queens | 4 Bunks | 2 Rollaways
📺 12 Smart TVs
🍳 2 Fully Stocked Kitchens
🌿 2 Private Balconies
Each unit has 2 Car Garage
